title: Early Pregnancy Units (EPU) | NHS inform
text:
Early Pregnancy Units (EPU)
An early pregnancy unit (EPU) is a specialised department that cares for people during the early stages of pregnancy. They can support you with any problems or concerns you may have before 12 weeks.
You can self-refer to an EPU at any time until the 12th week of your pregnancy. After this, you should contact your local maternity department instead.
